checks.name: 보수·순자산 순위 합 상위 3(순서)
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM (SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) ASC) + RANK() OVER (ORDER BY TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) DESC) AS s, TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE) AS aum, pd_itm_no FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE)>0 AND TRY_CAST(pd_net_tamt AS DOUBLE)>0) ORDER BY s, aum DESC, pd_itm_no LIMIT 3

checks.name: KOSPI 200 표기 ETF 총보수 오름차순
checks.sql: SELECT pd_abrv_nm, pd_nm FROM kr_etp WHERE drv_instrument_type='ETF' AND drv_listing_status='active' AND (pd_nm ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR pd_abrv_nm ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%' OR coalesce(cu_base_index, ref_base_index) ILIKE '%KOSPI%200%') AND TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE) > 0 ORDER BY TRY_CAST(cu_charge_rt AS DOUBLE), pd_itm_no LIMIT 20
